name: subagent
description: Delegate a self-contained task to a fresh, isolated sub-agent and return its result. The sub-agent never receives more access than its caller.

configSchema.label: Retention
configSchema.hint: How long a finished delegation stays collectable.

configSchema.label: Result retention (ms)
configSchema.hint: How long after finishing a background delegation or a workflow can still be read with DelegateStatus, DelegateResult or WorkflowStatus. Past it the entry is forgotten and the id no longer resolves. Range 10 minutes to 24 hours, default 1 hour.

configSchema.label: Stall watchdog
configSchema.hint: When a delegated sub-agent that has gone silent is aborted.

configSchema.label: Stall timeout (minutes)
configSchema.hint: How long a delegated sub-agent may go with no sign of life (no tool starts, no step boundaries) before it is aborted as stalled. The verdict is recoverable with DelegateContinue, so it is only a safety net for a genuinely wedged child — raise it for deep analyses that think for long stretches. Range 5 minutes to 4 hours, default 1 hour.

strings.title: Agents
strings.sectionHint: Typed agents the assistant can delegate to. Built-in explore and plan ship read-only; add your own.
strings.deleteDesc: The agent “{name}” will be removed permanently.
strings.name: Name
strings.toolsHint: Tools the agent may use. Read-only provides non-editing tools and a shell limited to non-destructive commands.
strings.customToolsHint: Comma-separated tool names, e.g. Read, Search, Bash.
strings.helpName: kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and dashes (e.g. “code-reviewer”).
strings.helpDescription: One line: when to delegate to this agent (the assistant reads it to choose).
strings.helpBody: The agent’s system prompt — its role, constraints and how to report back.
